topic: How does frequency selection between S and Ka bands impact link budget margins for transparent payloads?
consensus_response: Frequency selection between S and Ka bands significantly impacts link budget margins for transparent payloads. Ka-band frequencies offer higher capacity but are more susceptible to rain attenuation and scintillation, reducing link quality. In contrast, S-band frequencies provide better link budget margins with reduced atmospheric attenuation and path loss. The increased complexity of Ka-band systems is offset by their higher capacity and potential for reduced interference, but comes at the expense of increased system mass, power consumption, and launch costs.
